list: Official 55-trophy list, frozen 2026-11-18 (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade)

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours; there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow this guide's six stages in order and the last trophy you earn will almost always be A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion. The requirement itself is the official description, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission of the game, so this pops early in Chapter 1 with no optional work needed. Story trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned, which is why this one sits behind the spoiler setting here.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — PowerPyx reports it is the one missable step in the whole game and it feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy. Nothing else in Chapter 1 can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapter 2 is also when you first get both characters to play as, which matters for the meditation spots and the partner trophies later. No optional content in this chapter is needed for the trophy itself.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. As with the other chapter trophies, only the story missions count — side content can wait for the cleanup stages. Keep chipping away at the long counters (stunts, vehicles, areas) as you travel between missions so they do not become a grind at the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. By now the stranger mission strands and the side characters' final missions are opening up — start their chains in stage 2 of the roadmap rather than leaving them all for after the story. PowerPyx's roadmap makes the same point: do the optional missions alongside the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission and this gold trophy pops with the credits. It is the last story trophy, so everything after it is cleanup: side characters, activities, collectibles and the 100% checklist. Some guides word this as completing Chapter 5; the official description says the final mission, and that is what this guide uses.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, with no special requirement — just play the mission through. Mission-name trophies like this one are why the spoiler setting hides story names until you earn them.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story-gated, so this one arrives on its own as you play through the chapters — you cannot attempt it early or miss it. It pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it needs nothing beyond completing the mission itself. If you are tracking progress here, tick it off as soon as it pops so the roadmap's stage 1 count stays honest.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It pops at the mission's end with no extra objective. The name is a spoiler in itself, which is why it stays hidden behind the spoiler toggle until earned.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The mission is part of the story, so it cannot be missed — it pops when the mission ends. The airport also matters for the Catch Me If You Can trophy later, so remember the layout.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the later story missions, so it pops near the end of the story run. Completing it leaves only the final mission between you and the story gold.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. That checklist is the long tail of the platinum: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges all feed it. PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at roughly 200 hours and rates the set 4 out of 10 in difficulty — the grind is length, not skill. Do the meditation spots, the 50 challenges and the stranger strands before you declare yourself done, since those are the checklist items players most often leave unfinished.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near misses and airtime moments count toward the total as you drive around Leonida. Do not save this for last: stunt counters climb naturally during story driving, so start noticing them from Chapter 1 and mop up the remainder with repeated jumps in the open world. PSN tracks the count to 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — one session of each is enough, you do not need to master any of them. The 9 types are the game's activities (races, fishing, arcade, bowling, shooting range, drone races and the rest); the tracker in this guide lists them in the activity filter so you can see which ones you have tried. PSN tracks the count to 9.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the range's courses, and each needs a gold-medal score, so this is a skill trophy rather than a grind — practice one course at a time and use the range's own feedback to see which targets cost you time. The count of 42 is what PSN tracks.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race, so work through them one at a time and learn each course's corners before chasing the win. The 14 locations are the ones PSN counts; the race markers appear on the map as you explore.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Mix race types (street, off-road, water) and work through the map's race markers; wins you already took during the story still count. PSN tracks the count to 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are one of the activity types, so find Cal at a fishing spot and win the head-to-head. It pops as soon as you beat him — no series or rematch is needed. This is one of the few trophies with a named rival, so it is easy to plan around once fishing is unlocked.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade. Any arcade cabinet works — pick the shortest game you can find and play it to its end. It is a one-and-done trophy, so do it the first time you pass an arcade and never think about it again.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. Side-character chains unlock as the story progresses and their missions appear on the map; work them when they appear rather than leaving them all for after the story, since some quest givers go temporarily unavailable during the story — PowerPyx flags Kenton for this, and the same caution applies to the other chains. The trophy pops at the chain's last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. PowerPyx specifically warns that Kenton can become temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, so take his missions when they appear instead of postponing them. The trophy pops at the chain's last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. Like the other side-character chains, it unlocks through the story and its missions appear on the map as you progress. Finish the chain and the trophy pops at the last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions are the question-mark encounters scattered around the map; a strand is a chain, so one meeting is not enough — follow each stranger's chain to its end. Some early guides report that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start them when they appear rather than hoarding them for the endgame. PSN tracks the count to 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. Randy's chain is one of five side-character chains with its own trophy, alongside Andy, Kenton, Billy and Tyrone. Take the missions as they appear on the map during the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. The chain unlocks through story progress; its missions appear on the map, and the trophy pops at the final one. If a chain's giver seems absent, keep playing the story — PowerPyx notes some givers go temporarily unavailable and return later.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 meditations across 10 spot locations, because most spots count once per character (Jason and Lucia each meditate). Track progress in the game under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house, is only available in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia walks to the balcony in the morning and invites you to meditate; follow her and accept. PowerPyx reports it is gone after Chapter 1 and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe. The final spot, Ascent Mountain, only opens after all the others are done. 15 of 18 meditations are enough for the 100% checklist, but the trophy needs all of them.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's request is a stranger-style hunt: follow his lead to the animal, track it and take it down. The trophy pops when the hunt is complete. It is the only hunting trophy in the list, so it stands apart from the other side chains.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible; a set is complete when you hold every card in it, and you need three finished sets. Pick up cards whenever you pass them during the story and use the map's collectible filters to mop up the rest — the counts are tracked in the game's collections menu. PSN tracks the count to 3 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are spread over the whole map, so this is a travel trophy: it climbs as you explore, and the last stretch is a deliberate sweep of places you have not visited. Check the map's exploration filter to see which areas are still unmarked. PSN tracks the count to 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges are the small goals layered over everything else — driving, combat, exploration and activities all have them — so they accumulate while you play. Open the challenges menu regularly and chase the ones closest to done; the count is tracked there and by PSN to 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the police and escape. The partner matters — the trophy needs both of you in the escape, so do it during a mission or free-roam stretch where your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of the usual escape: keep the heat on you the whole time and move straight from one shop to the next. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and do not let the stars drop between them. It pops after the third robbery.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Vehicles are logged when you get close to or drive a new model, so variety is the goal: try every car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass instead of sticking to one favourite. The game's vehicle log shows what you have found, and PSN tracks the count to 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd — five or more enemies close together — then trigger Combat Focus and chain the takedowns before it ends. If you only get three or four, reload the fight and try a busier spot; the count must happen inside one activation.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave by air without a scheduled flight. Take a plane from the airport and get airborne on your own terms; the trophy pops once you are away. It is one of the hidden one-off stunt trophies, so it stays behind the spoiler toggle until earned.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The official description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and the exact trigger is a tank encounter: get into a situation with Rhino tanks and deal with them. Early guides have not pinned the precise steps yet, so treat this as a combat trophy that resolves during high-wanted-level play with the military hardware involved — and check the cited PowerPyx roadmap for updates as players confirm it. The description itself is the only official fact; anything beyond it here is labelled as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so plan the entry and exit first and keep it slow.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are the bigger heist-style robberies of the open world: hit the vault, then lose the police and get clear — the escape is part of the trophy, a robbery that ends in a bust does not count. Five successful vault jobs, with escapes, earn the silver. PSN tracks the count to 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and then lose the police. The escape is part of the requirement, so do not stop fighting the wanted level until the stars are gone.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map is divided into 52 named areas and the trophy needs every one visited. It climbs naturally during the story, then becomes a deliberate sweep: open the map, find the areas you have never entered, and drive through each. The area count is tracked in the game's exploration menu and by PSN to 52.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang, nine in total. The operations are marked on the map as you discover them, so work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which ones you have done — this guide's tracker helps. PSN tracks the count to 9.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the beachfront on Ocean Beach, find the bar or seating with the ocean view, and order the cocktail. It is a small moment trophy — one drink, one view, and it pops. Early guides have not pinned the exact bar yet, so if the first spot does nothing, try the other beachfront bars along Ocean Drive.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or lined up at the entrance, and punch through the glass at speed. The 'classic style' wording is a nod to the series' history; the trophy pops on the smash-out itself.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the 'follow-through' is a full game of bowling, bowled to the end. Find the alley, start a game and finish all frames. It is a one-and-done activity trophy, and bowling also counts toward the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and early guides have not pinned down the exact trigger yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy among those not yet known at launch. The wording points at a partner moment with a crowd or an audience; play the story and the partner activities through, and check the cited PowerPyx roadmap for the confirmed trigger once players find it. This guide does not invent a step it cannot cite.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. The 'choices' are the small decisions layered through the game, so the counter climbs as you play: dialogue choices, activity decisions and the little forks the game offers. There is no single moment to chase; just keep playing and choosing, and the count will reach 500 across a full playthrough. Check the game's progress menu to see where the counter stands.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the trophy's name and description point at retrying something and getting it right the second time. Early guides have not confirmed the exact activity it attaches to, and PowerPyx lists it among the not-yet-known trophies at launch. The honest advice is: when you fail an activity or challenge, retry it immediately instead of walking away — the second-try success is the trigger, and this guide will cite the confirmed source once players pin it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description is the whole clue, and the trophy is one of the hidden oddities in the list. Early guides have not confirmed the exact event, and PowerPyx lists it among the not-yet-known trophies at launch. These 'what just happened' trophies in the series usually attach to a rare random event or an easter egg in the open world, so keep your eyes open while exploring and check the cited roadmap for the confirmed trigger. Nothing here is invented.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl the target over. You need speed and a target on foot: line up a drive-by with a bat or similar melee weapon and connect while the vehicle is moving. It pops on the hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut, and the laundered total is what counts. Keep laundering after every big job and the $250,000 target arrives on its own — PSN tracks the amount. Spend the clean money on the Treat Yo Self and Little Boxes goals while you are at it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, food, weapons, car parts — so this climbs while you play normally. If you reach the endgame short of the total, buy high-value items you actually want (cars and property upgrades count too) rather than wasting money. PSN tracks the amount to $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are the properties that store your vehicles; each one costs money, so save up and buy them as they appear on the property market. The count is 8, and the purchase menu shows which ones you already own. This pairs naturally with the money trophies — launder and spend, then buy the last garage.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on the in-game phone, register vehicles you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are listed. It is a quick cleanup trophy once you have a few vehicles — pair it with the vehicle discovery sweep for Whip It Good. PSN tracks the count to 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
